name: Right at the root
why: 4 comes up and becomes the root; 5 moves across to be 6's left child. Level order: [4, 2, 6, None, None, 5, 7]. Return the new root.

name: Left at the root
why: 6 comes up; 5 moves across to be 4's right child: [6, 4, 7, 2, 5].

name: A left child, deeper down
show: the TREE lessons' tree (8; 3, 10; 1, 6, 14; 4, 7, 13); rotate left at 3
why: 6 comes up in 3's place, so 8's left child must now be 6. If 8 still points to 3, the parent's link was not fixed, and 6 with its subtree is lost.

name: A right child, deeper down
show: the same tree; rotate left at 10
why: 14 comes up in 10's place, so 8's right child must become 14, with 10 as 14's left child and 13 as 10's right child.

name: Right, near a leaf
show: the same tree; rotate right at 14
why: 13 comes up as 10's right child, and 14 becomes 13's right child.

name: Same nodes
expect: [[8, 3, 10, 1, 4, None, 14, None, None, None, 6, 13, None, None, 7], True]
expr: (lambda r: (lambda before: (lambda nr: [levels(nr), sorted(map(id, tnodes(nr))) == before])(rotate(r, args[1], args[2])))(sorted(map(id, tnodes(r)))))(bst(args[0]))
show: the same tree; rotate right at 6: [the tree, made of the same node objects?]
why: A rotation only changes links. If the second value is False, the code built new nodes instead of moving the old ones.

name: There and back
show: tree 6; 4, 7; 2, 5; rotate right at 6, then left at 4
why: A left rotation undoes a right rotation: the tree is back to [6, 4, 7, 2, 5].

name: 50,000 nodes
expr: (lambda r: (lambda n: (lambda nr: (lambda v: [n.value, len(v), all(v[i] < v[i + 1] for i in range(len(v) - 1)), height(nr)])(inorder(nr)))(rotate(r, n.value, 'right')))(next(x for x in tnodes(r)[30_000:] if x.left is not None)))(bst(args[0]))
show: a search tree of 50,000 keys; rotate right at a node deep in the tree: [its key, size, still in order?, height]
why: Finding the node walks one path, O(h); the rotation itself is O(1). If the size dropped, a link was lost; if the order broke, a subtree was attached on the wrong side.
